rationale: Recommend no. The held Federal Register text of EO 12007 (42 FR 42839) terminates the Board and revokes Executive Order No. 11962 of January 19, 1977 in section 5, with no deferred effect or savings wording, on August 22, 1977, before the order's own December 31, 1978 sunset; the 22 U.S.C. 3107 note and the OFR catalog agree. No surviving command was found, so the order was not in force on 2026-10-14.
